_doc: Practice / Tutorial drills (M12). setup: who has the ball (offense = you), the spot (ballOn = yards from your goal line), down and distance; play = a fixed play (else you call it), call/front = the defense's look; kick = a field goal drill. goal: complete (a completion), gain (yards >= n), fieldGoal (it's good), stop (the offense gains < n), motion (gain >= n with motion or an audible used). reps = successes needed. hints = show the defense's assignments and the coverage read before the snap.

drills.title: Passing
steps: Pick a PASS play, then tap SNAP.
Pull back from anywhere on the field and release: the ball flies the opposite way, like a slingshot.
A short pull floats a lob over defenders; a long pull fires a bullet.
Throw where your receiver is going, not where he is.

drills.title: Running
steps: The ball goes to your back after the snap.
Hold a finger (or the arrow keys) where you want him to run; let go and he follows his blocks.
JUKE / SPIN make the next tackle harder; BURST is a short sprint (Space, E, Shift).

drills.title: Kicking
steps: Flick up through the ball: the length of the flick is the power.
Bend the swipe to curve the kick into the wind.
The yellow cone is how far off your kicker can miss: keep the line inside the posts.

drills.title: Reading coverage
steps: Before the snap you can see the defense's assignments this time: blue circles are zones, red lines man coverage, yellow arrows rushers.
Cover 2: two deep safeties split the field, five defenders underneath.
Attack the hole on the sideline between the corner and the safety (15-22 yards), or the middle seam between the safeties.

drills.title: Motion & audibles
drills.summary: Use motion or an audible and gain 4+ yards twice
steps: After you call a play you line up: open MOTION and send a receiver across.
If a defender follows him, it's man coverage; if nobody does, it's zone.
Don't like the look? AUDIBLE to another play, or set a HOT ROUTE, then SNAP.

drills.title: Defense
drills.summary: Hold the offense under 4 yards three times
steps: You see their personnel group before you call: more receivers = more likely a pass.
Pick a front and a coverage (or COACH'S CALL).
Turn on CONTROL DEFENDER to play one man yourself: steer him, DIVE, SWAT, STRIP, SWITCH.

coverage.cover0: Cover 0: everyone in man, no deep help, six or more rushing. Get the ball out fast: any win is a big play.
coverage.cover1: Cover 1: man coverage with one deep safety. Crossers and rub routes beat it; so do go routes away from the safety.
coverage.cover1_spy: Cover 1 Spy: man coverage, one deep, a spy on the QB. Don't scramble; throw crossers.
coverage.cover2: Cover 2: two deep safeties, five underneath. The holes are the sideline between corner and safety, and the deep middle.
coverage.cover2man: 2-Man: man coverage underneath, two deep. Beat your man on a short route; the deep ball is covered.
coverage.tampa2: Tampa 2: Cover 2 with the middle linebacker running to the deep middle. Throw the seams or the sideline.
coverage.cover3: Cover 3: three deep, four underneath. The flats and the seams between the zones are open; curls and outs work.
coverage.cover3_buzz: Cover 3 Buzz: a safety rotates down to the hook. Hit the flat or a deep out.
coverage.cover4: Cover 4: four deep, the run fits from the safeties. Short underneath and the flats are open.
coverage.cover6: Cover 6: quarters on one side, Cover 2 on the other. Attack the Cover 2 side's sideline hole.
coverage.prevent: Prevent: deep zones everywhere. Take the free underneath yards and get out of bounds.
coverage.fire_zone: Fire zone: a five-man blitz with three deep, three underneath. Hot routes to where the blitz came from.
coverage.mike_fire: Mike fire: the middle linebacker blitzes. The middle of the field behind him is open.
coverage.run_stop: Run stop: an extra man in the box. Play action and passes over the linebackers.
coverage.default: Count the deep safeties: one high = Cover 1 or 3; two high = Cover 2, 4 or 6. A man following motion = man coverage.
